description: Add tags to a whole filtered audience in the background. Returns a durable operation ID; poll get_subscriber_operation or list_subscriber_operations. Reuse requestKey after an uncertain response; changing inputs with the same key is rejected. Tagging needs subscribers:tag, new definitions need tags:write, and triggerAutomations needs automations:trigger. Existing synchronous bulk tag tools remain suitable for up to 500 explicit contacts.

audience.description: Omit for all contacts. Provide either root or filters. Contacts are selected in live bounded pages before applying tags; contacts created after the request are excluded.

root.description: Nested filter group, maximum depth eight.

companyId.description: Company ID override; otherwise uses the selected company.

requestKey.description: Required unique idempotency key for this request.

tags.description: Required for add_tags: 1 to 25 tag names.

name: start_subscriber_operation

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `start_subscriber_operation` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

failures.description: List of contact failure sample records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

status.description: queued, running, completed, failed or cancelled

succeeded.description: Successfully processed contacts, including unchanged tags

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
